markers.name: Helm_V1
say: Subordinate, please take care of yourself.
markers.label: Character 352

markers.name: MPNikke_A_V1
say: The concentration of Alva Particles here is very high.

Something has contaminated this place.
We must report it immediately.
markers.label: Character 300

markers.name: MPNikke_B_V1
say: It halted for just a second, so please be careful.
We are awaiting new orders from the Ark.
markers.label: Character 304

markers.name: Neon_V1
say: What kind of firepower is this?
markers.label: Character 11

markers.name: Anchor_V10
say: Everyone under the sea is happily swimming.
markers.label: Character 351

markers.name: Anis_V10
say: Goodbye, everyone! You all did a good job!
markers.label: Character 12

markers.name: Helm_V10
say: That's right. The Admire is our proud partner.
markers.label: Character 352

markers.name: Laplace_V10
say:
Birdie, is it time to sail back now?
Hmmm...
markers.label: Character 100

markers.name: MPNikke_A_V10
say:
Mission complete.
Everyone, you did an amazing job.
markers.label: Character 300

markers.name: Mast_V10
say: Pirates don't just overlook passing sights.
Our next adventure is the goal! Right, Morgan?
markers.label: Character 350

markers.name: Neon_V10
say: I'll soon have to part ways with my firepower partner.
markers.label: Character 11

markers.name: Rapi_V10
say: Perhaps... one day, we'll meet them again.
markers.label: Character 10

markers.name: Rita_V10
say: Soon, we'll be tearing all of this down.

I've been feeling down for a while.
Hmm, Greenhorn, have you felt the same?
markers.label: Character 82

markers.name: MPNikke_A_V2
say: Our priority is to protect this ship.

Reinforcements will arrive soon. 
We'll hold them off.
markers.label: Character 300

markers.name: Research_A_V2
say: A zero-gravity phenomenon has appeared around the tower.

Everything has turned red...
What in the world is the reason?
markers.label: Researcher

markers.name: Anis_V3
say:
The phantom is still watching this place.
Ugh, it's so annoying.
markers.label: Character 12

markers.name: Helm_V3
say:
We and the Admire are ready.
Subordinate, give the order!
markers.label: Character 352

markers.name: MPNikke_A_V3
say:
Proceed with confidence!
We've got this area covered. No matter what happens.
markers.label: Character 300

markers.name: Rapi_V3
say: We will prevent this phenomenon from spreading.
markers.label: Character 10

markers.name: Rita_V3
say: There are so many things broken all over the place!
markers.label: Character 82

markers.name: Drake_V4
say:
Hehehe, is this the start of the downfall?
Stop it? All right, understood.
markers.label: Character 101

markers.name: Helm_V4
say: The Admire and I won't let our guard down.
Subordinate, you should rest a bit more.
markers.label: Character 352

markers.name: Laplace_V4
say: Have no fear! The hero will take care of everything!
markers.label: Character 100

markers.name: Mast_V4
say: A victory party? Now that's amazing. Don't you agree, Captain?
markers.label: Character 350

markers.name: Neon_V4
say: At this very moment, all the stars of firepower gathered here!
Heh... I'll see it for myself.
markers.label: Character 11

markers.name: Rita_V4
say:
But we have Mighty Tools here.
Nothing can't be fixed!
markers.label: Character 82

markers.name: Drake_V5
say:
Behold, this amazing sight!
Hmm? Sitting here is dangerous? Then, I shall leave.
markers.label: Character 101

markers.name: Helm_V5
say: No matter what happens, I will protect you.
markers.label: Character 352

markers.name: Laplace_V5
say: Do not worry! The hero will protect everyone!
Birdie, I'm ready to take action!
markers.label: Character 100

markers.name: MPNikke_A_V5
say:
Nothing would be a surprise at this point.
Don't wander around outside recklessly!
markers.label: Character 300

markers.name: Rita_V5
say: We're already building it at full speed... Next!
markers.label: Character 82

markers.name: Helm_V6
say: This is the true final battle.
Subordinate, the Admire and I will stay with you until the very end.
markers.label: Character 352

markers.name: Laplace_V6
say: Rest assured. Clearing the way is the hero's duty!
markers.label: Character 100

markers.name: MPNikke_A_V6
say:
I'm scared... and afraid.
But I will protect this place until the very end.
markers.label: Character 300

markers.name: Rapi_V6
say: Commander, no matter what happens, I will protect you.
markers.label: Character 10

markers.name: Anchor_V7
say: I miss my friends in the ocean.
markers.label: Character 351

markers.name: Anis_V7
say: Ah, it looks like everyone's really gone...
Well, that just means I get to enjoy more time with you here, Commander!
markers.label: Character 12

markers.name: Drake_V7
say:
The sea has turned so blue that I almost want to drink it.
No? Fine, I won't.
markers.label: Character 101

markers.name: Helm_V7
say: I'm grateful to be sailing with you.
I will never forget this beautiful sea.
markers.label: Character 352

markers.name: Laplace_V7
say: Birdie, don't worry. A hero is 24/7 vigilant!
markers.label: Character 100

markers.name: MPNikke_A_V7
say:
No D-Wave reactions were detected.
Nonetheless, we'll continue our patrols.
markers.label: Character 300

markers.name: Mast_V7
say: Haha! I wonder what new things we'll catch this time!
markers.label: Character 350

markers.name: Maxwell_V7
say: After fighting so hard, we deserve a well-deserved rest.
markers.label: Character 102

markers.name: Neon_V7
say: Ohh, I will engrave the greatness of this firepower into my core!
Master, I will train even harder!
markers.label: Character 11

markers.name: Pepper_V7
say:
There are no confirmed casualties.
What a relief, really.
markers.label: Character 131

markers.name: Rapi_V7
say: So, this is the beauty of the sea.
There are still Raptures nearby, so we must remain alert.
I hope you like this beautiful view, Commander.
markers.label: Character 10

markers.name: ReSearcher_A_V7
say: Will I never have the chance to uncover the truth behind these strange phenomena?
If you thought I'd let this pass, retreating would have never crossed my mind...
markers.label: Researcher

markers.name: Rita_V7
say:
This time, I'm really exhausted.
Hey, Greenhorn! Stop loitering around in front of me!
markers.label: Character 82

markers.name: Helm_V8
say: Will your heart also find peace once the waves settle?
I've gained so much from this battle.
markers.label: Character 352

markers.name: Laplace_V8
say: A hero must set an example. I will stand right here!
I shall help defeat those villains on the sea!
markers.label: Character 100

markers.name: Pepper_V8
say: The air here is so fresh.
markers.label: Character 131

markers.name: Anis_V9
say: What? That guy seriously wants to have a diving contest with me?
Commander, can I switch to my swimming body?
markers.label: Character 12

markers.name: Drake_V9
say: For the greatest villain, diving is a piece of cake!
What? We need to chase the Raptures? Got it.
markers.label: Character 101

markers.name: Maxwell_V9
say:
Look at those morons.
Oh, Cutey, want to join me in watching these fools?
markers.label: Character 102

notes.text: The phantom has caused an unbelievable phenomenon.
A temporary moment of peace has come.
The visitors from the other world have left.
Parts of the sea and the beach have been purified.
